messages:
maria_marketing: Hey team — planning a short announcement for the Optimize v1.3 rollout next week. Need final changelog, docs preview link, and rollout timing from eng. Can we align today? :calendar:
jamal_eng: Hi — we can share a concise changelog now. Full rollout plan after sync with SRE. Are we aiming for blog + tweet + docs update on day 1?
sana_pm: Yep — marketing wants day-1 blog + appendix in docs + webinar signup. Suggest canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h. Jamal, is that safe?
jamal_eng: 10% canary is fine. Risk items: quantization profile update may change tail latency on long prompts, and cache warm-up might spike token cost. We'll include fallback to previous model variant if latency > 500ms p50 for 5m.
maria_marketing: Good — can you paste a short changelog snippet we can use in the post and release notes? We need 2-3 bullet highlights.
jamal_eng: Sure — paste below:
```
- Improve batching heuristics to reduce avg token cost by ~18%
- New auto-prefix KV cache to speed up repeated conversational context
- Support for int8 quantization profile v2 with parity on top-k sampling
```
oliver_docs: Docs preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/optimize-v1.3 (internal only) — staging page has the new config examples and migration guide. Please don't share publicly until we flip the publish flag.
rachael_sales: Heads-up: sales needs two one-pagers with TL;DR and impact numbers (cost drop, latency improvements) for next week's customer calls. Can marketing produce, or want eng numbers?
maria_marketing: We'll draft the one-pager — can we get the cost delta number verified? jamal, is 18% avg token cost reduction measured on our internal bench?
jamal_eng: 18% is median across batched text-gen workloads in our benchmark suite. I'll attach the bench id and timeframe in the thread.
simon_sre: From SRE side, suggested rollout window: Wed 02:00–06:00 UTC to avoid major US morning traffic. Monitoring hooks we need enabled: latency p50/p95, token cost per request, and error-rate by model variant. Add a rollout abort condition: p95 latency > 1200ms or error-rate increase > 1.5x baseline.
maria_marketing: Wed 02:00–06:00 UTC works for the announcement? Marketing will plan the blog to go live at 06:30 UTC right after full release.
sana_pm: Make sure canary traffic is routed by routing policy tag so we can measure cohort differences. Jamal, can you add a trace label 'optimize_v1.3_canary' for the first 10%?
jamal_eng: Yep will add trace label and flag in logs.
oliver_docs: Reminder: migration note snippet is ready — add to blog: "No action required for most users; opt-in available via model param 'quant_profile: v2'".
maria_marketing: Perfect. Action items: Jamal—final changelog + bench id + publish-ready statement by EOD today. Oliver—unpublish link -> publish link when deploy-bot confirms prod deploy. Rachael—give us 2 customer personas for the one-pager by EOD. Sana—confirm canary percentages in rollout config. Simon—prepare SLO monitors and abort rules.
jamal_eng: On it. I'll post the bench id and a short one-paragraph engineer quote for the blog in ~3h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for optimize-service -> optimize-v1.3 on 1768509120 (Wed 02:00 UTC). Canary phase: 10% for 30m; ramp to 50% for 6h; full rollout at success.
maria_marketing: Great — I'll schedule the content calendar and draft the tweet thread. Thanks all — will follow up in a quick 15-min sync if anyone's free. :thumbsup:
